name: HR Policy Q&A Bot (AI Automation Projects #21)

parameters.content:
## HR Policy Q&A Bot
Staff ask in plain English; the bot answers from the handbook and cites the section, or says it doesn't know.

POST `{question}` from Slack, WhatsApp or a web chat. The handbook (HANDBOOK constant; paste your own with ## headings) is split into sections and ranked with TF-IDF. The answer quotes the best section and cites it; low-confidence questions are routed to HR instead of guessed.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/hr-policy-qa-bot
